description: This PHP file defines a controller class for managing 'special' module configurations in OpenCart's admin panel. It includes methods for displaying settings, saving, adding, and deleting modules, and interacts with models and views related to the special modules.

classes.name: Special
classes.description: Controller class for managing the special module configuration in the admin interface of OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the module configuration page, loading current settings and preparing data for the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the module configuration, performing permission checks, validation, and updating the database.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new special module with default settings, after permission check.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specific module instance by module_id, after permission check.
